criteria.quote: Dragonite may have an island. One survivor reached it.
criteria.revision: Replace the opening with: "Dragonite is said to rescue people at sea—but one account names a very different destination." This preserves the tension while avoiding the unsupported phrasing "one survivor reached it" and delaying the island reveal.

criteria.quote: Dragonite may have an island. One survivor reached it.
criteria.revision: Replace "one survivor" with the research's precise wording, "a shipwrecked man," and say: "One entry says Dragonite took a shipwrecked man to a remote island."

criteria.quote: Did Dragonite rescue one man, or lead him somewhere no one else lives?
criteria.revision: Change the open loop to: "If Dragonite took him to that island, could the rescue account also be evidence that the Dragonite-only island is real?" This creates a question the ending can answer without treating rescue and destination as opposites.

criteria.quote: Other entries say Dragonite guides crews from shipwrecks to shore. Then another entry says Dragonite saved a shipwrecked man.
criteria.revision: Reorder the middle so the general rescue reports establish a pattern, the shipwrecked man becomes the specific case, and only then reveal that his reported destination was a remote island inhabited solely by Dragonite.

criteria.quote: Dragonite may have an island. One survivor reached it.
criteria.revision: Move "island" out of the title and first scene. Open with: "Dragonite is said to rescue drowning people—but one account names a very different destination." Reveal the remote Dragonite-only paradise only in the final third.

criteria.quote: One Pokédex entry says Dragonite lives on an island alone.
criteria.revision: Give each beat a distinct job: use the rescue-pattern scene for repeated reports of helping drowning people, the next scene for the specific shipwrecked man, and the island scene for the separate claim that only Dragonite live there. Remove either the early island claim or the later repeated island reveal.

criteria.quote: One account says Dragonite took a shipwrecked man to a remote paradise occupied solely by Dragonite.
criteria.revision: End with a synthesis rather than repeating the line: "The rescue and the island may be connected: Dragonite saved the man—but the reported destination was a paradise occupied solely by Dragonite." Keep "may be connected" because the research does not explicitly say the two accounts describe the same event.

criteria.quote: Do you see a rescue, or a secret Dragonite island?
criteria.revision: Replace it with: "Are these two entries describing one rescue destination—or two separate Dragonite legends?" Both positions remain credible because the research reports the rescue and the Dragonite-only island without explicitly linking them.
